newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Index traders gearing up for Nov expiry.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Index traders gearing up for Nov expiry.

text.p: Index options traders were gearing up on Wednesday for the expiration of November FTSE 100 options, and betting the effect would be modestly to the upside.

Most of the open interest in the American-style index options were in the November 3950 and November 4000 options, which suggests the underlying market may push toward those strikes when the November contracts expire on Friday morning, traders said.
By 1515 GMT, the leading blue chip index was down 8.3 points to 3,926.0.
Put volume was two-and-a-half times that of volume recorded on the call side in the American-style options, and volume was heaviest in November 3900 puts, where more than 3,700 lots traded.
Among the biggest single deals in index options was the sale of a 2,500 lot in the November 3900 puts at 5p, traders said.
Activity in stock options was sparse, with few strategy trades carried out.
Traders noted the sale of 1,000 January 750 puts on Reuters Holdings at 23-1/2p, one of the largest trades in equity options today.
Reuters shares were down 4-1/2p to 742p, about 9.4 percent off their high for the year.
Traders also noted the purchase of 1,000 December 90 calls on UK retailer Sears Plc. The shares were up 2p to 89p.
Elsewhere, 375 January 600 calls were bought on Commercial Union CUAC.O at 58p, traders said.
Shares in Commercial Union advanced 3-1/2p to 642-1/2 after the UK insurer released its nine-month financial results earlier. *FOR FUTURES AND OPTIONS EXPIRY DATES PLEASE SEE PAGE UKA4 *
